members.tone: Blunt and informal where *believe* is plain, it treats accepting a claim as taking something on offer, so the acceptance sounds weighed rather than simply held.
The unmarked word for taking something to be true, carrying no judgement on whether the acceptance was earned.
Softer than *believe*: it presents the belief as settled information one has come by, which lets the speaker hold it lightly.
Disparaging of the believer rather than the claim, since the gloss builds the absence of questioning into the acceptance itself.
Formal, and it frames the belief as arrived at rather than merely held, giving it a footing *believe* does not claim.
